arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS Cliente, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS Importo FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE customers.country = 'ES' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name

arguments.subject: Importi 2026 clienti ES
arguments.body: Ecco il foglio con l'importo totale ordinato nel 2026 da ogni cliente del paese ES.
